hotel.name: Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund

verified_facts.text: The hotel lies on the bank of the Huangpu River in Shanghai.
verified_facts.excerpt: on the bank of the Huangpu River, lies Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund

verified_facts.text: All rooms and suites have views of the Huangpu River and the skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: A fine urban resort on the bund, with spectacular views of the Huangpu river and the iconic skyline from all of its 130 rooms and suites.

verified_facts.text: The Bund Oasis with Romantic Pool room has a private dipping pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: A relaxing oasis where you can unwind in your private dipping pool

verified_facts.text: The Banyan Suite has panoramic views of the Huangpu River, the Bund and the city skyline, with personal host service.
verified_facts.excerpt: The pinnacle of Shanghai experience with unmatched panoramic views of the Huangpu River, the Bund and the city skyline, complete with your personal host service

verified_facts.text: The Grand Bund Suite has a deep round soaking tub in a modern bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature a deep round soaking tub in a modern bathroom to further refine the experience

verified_facts.text: The Grand Riverside Suite has a king-size bed with an extensive Pillow Menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: a king-size bed with quality linens and an extensive Pillow Menu

verified_facts.text: The Junior Riverside Suite has large glass windows facing the river and a chaise longue to enjoy the view.
verified_facts.excerpt: Large glass windows give you the perfect vantage point of the river, complemented with a deep round soaking tub, carefully chosen furnishings and an elegant chaise longue to enjoy the view from.

verified_facts.text: TALES is a rooftop bar on the banks of the Huangpu River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched above the vibrant cityscape of Shanghai and nestled on the banks of Huangpu River, TALES is more than just a rooftop bar

verified_facts.text: Prince Kitchen is a Cantonese restaurant with signature abalone dishes by Master Chef Mai Guangfan.
verified_facts.excerpt: An elegant and upscale Cantonese restaurant featuring refined cuisine, including signature abalone dishes by renowned Master Chef Mai Guangfan.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor pool and three relaxation pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: With an indoor pool and three relaxation pools, you can start each day relaxing or working out in cool, clear waters.

verified_facts.text: The fitness club includes a Yoga Studio and a fitness centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take part in a soulful yoga asana in the Yoga Studio, or keep your body in top shape in the fitness centre

verified_facts.text: The spa spans three floors and has an indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: head to the three-floor spa, an oasis-like retreat with an indoor pool and treatments that draw on Chinese, Thai, Indian, and Indonesian traditions

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments draw on Chinese, Thai, Indian and Indonesian traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: treatments that draw on Chinese, Thai, Indian, and Indonesian traditions

verified_facts.text: Guests can enjoy a Full Moon Destination Dining experience or a traditional Sundown Ritual at TALES.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a Full Moon Destination Dining experience, walk along The Bund, or come to the TALES Rooftop Restaurant and bar for a traditional Sundown Ritual.

verified_facts.text: Curated experiences range from riverside afternoon tea and bespoke spa treatments to cultural workshops.
verified_facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund offers a variety of curated experiences, from riverside afternoon tea and bespoke spa treatments to seasonal gala dinners and cultural workshops.

verified_facts.text: The Bund is about 10 minutes from the hotel by taxi.

verified_facts.text: Pudong International Airport is approximately 45 minutes away by car.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are approximately 45 minutes away from Shanghai Pudong International Airport by car.

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is free of charge for staying guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our valet parking service is free of charge for staying guests.
